name: Steal Your Heart!
source:
Fresh off his latest con, romance scammer Cherry has already set his sights on his next target. His plans are derailed when a former victim, still clinging to the feelings Cherry left behind, hires a detective to reunite them. 

Finding himself caught between the consequences of his actions and feelings he'd never planned for, how much longer can Cherry keep up his act?

[From [url=https://bunycube.itch.io/steal-your-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
刚刚完成最新的骗局，浪漫骗子Cherry已经将目光投向了下一个目标。当一名前受害者仍然对切瑞留下的感情耿耿于怀时，他聘请了一名侦探来让他们团聚，他的计划因此而脱轨。

发现自己陷入了自己行为的后果和从未计划过的感情之间，切里还能继续他的行为多久？

[来自[url=https://bunycube.itch.io/steal-your-heart]itch.io[/url]]
